tour.overview:
Few sights in the world match a Cappadocia sunrise: as the sky turns pink, up to a hundred balloons lift off together and drift over a landscape of soft volcanic rock carved by wind and water into cones, pillars and valleys, many of them hollowed out over the centuries into homes, churches and dovecotes. From the basket you look down into Love Valley, Rose Valley and Pigeon Valley, over the cave town of Göreme and the rock castle of Uçhisar, with the snowy cone of Mount Erciyes on the horizon.

We collect you from your hotel before dawn and drive you to the launch field, where you have a light breakfast and watch the crews inflate the balloons. Your pilot flies for about an hour, rising gently to several hundred metres and then dropping low into the valleys between the rock formations. After landing, the crew celebrates in the traditional way, you receive your flight certificate, and you are back at your hotel in time for a proper breakfast.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 3 to 3.5 hours, including about 1 hour of flight
• Start and end: your hotel in Göreme, Uçhisar, Ürgüp, Avanos or Ortahisar
• Type: shared basket with a licensed operator, standard or comfort class; private baskets on request
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy; you climb into the basket with steps

WHAT YOU SEE
• Sunrise over the Cappadocian plateau.
• The valleys around Göreme: Love Valley, Rose Valley, Red Valley and Pigeon Valley.
• Fairy chimneys, Uçhisar castle and Mount Erciyes.

WHY THIS WORKS
We work only with licensed operators that keep good safety records and reasonable basket sizes, and we book the flight early in your stay so there is time to rebook if the wind cancels the first morning.

WHO IT SUITS
Couples, families with children of about 6 and older, photographers and anyone celebrating a special occasion.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
If you are afraid of heights, watch the balloons rise from a viewpoint at sunrise instead, then join our Red Tour of Cappadocia.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
Flights depend on wind and are approved each morning by the civil aviation authority; cancellations are common in winter. Dress warmly, as early mornings can be cold even in summer, and wear flat closed shoes. Book at least two mornings in Cappadocia if the balloon is important to you.

days.name: Sunrise balloon flight over the valleys of Göreme
days.description:
What to expect: a sunrise balloon flight of about an hour with a licensed operator, breakfast, a landing celebration and hotel transfers.

Your driver collects you from your hotel about an hour before sunrise – around 4:30 in summer and 6:30 in winter – and takes you to the operator's base or directly to the launch field. You are given a light breakfast of tea, coffee, pastries and fruit and a short safety briefing, then you watch the crews unroll the envelopes, fill them with cold air from big fans and then heat it with the roaring burners until the balloons rise upright, glowing in the half-light. All around you, dozens of other balloons are doing the same.

You climb into the basket, which is divided into compartments, and lift off gently as the sky brightens. In the first minutes you rise above the valleys and see the sun come up over the plateau, lighting the soft rock in shades of pink, cream and gold. Your pilot steers by changing altitude to catch different breezes, sometimes climbing to around 800 or 1,000 metres for the wide panorama, sometimes dropping into the valleys to glide past fairy chimneys, rock-cut dovecotes and cave churches close enough to see their windows. Depending on the wind, you may pass over Love Valley with its tall pillars, Rose Valley, Red Valley, Pigeon Valley and the rock castle of Uçhisar, with Mount Erciyes on the horizon.

After about an hour the pilot brings the balloon down, often onto a trailer or a field where the ground crew is waiting. Once everyone is out, the crew packs the balloon and celebrates the landing in the traditional way with a toast, and you receive your flight certificate. Your driver takes you back to your hotel at about 8:00 to 9:00, in time for breakfast and a full day of exploring.

SCHEDULE (approximate times, adjusted to sunrise)
05:00 – Pick-up from your hotel (earlier in summer, later in winter).
05:20 – Light breakfast and safety briefing.
05:45 – Balloon inflation and boarding.
06:00 – Take-off and sunrise flight (about 1 hour).
07:15 – Landing, celebration and certificate.
08:00 – Return to your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Flights are approved each morning by the civil aviation authority. If cancelled for weather, we rebook you or refund you in full.
• Children under about 6 and pregnant travellers cannot fly. Tell us ages when you book.
• Standard baskets carry up to about 20 passengers in compartments; comfort baskets are smaller, and private baskets can be arranged.

INCLUDED: hotel transfers, balloon flight of about 1 hour, light breakfast, landing celebration, flight certificate, insurance.
NOT INCLUDED: photos or videos sold by the operator, tips for the pilot and crew.

Overnight: none.
Meals: light breakfast.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the flight is confirmed.

faq.question: Is ballooning in Cappadocia safe?
faq.answer: Flights are licensed and regulated by Turkey's civil aviation authority, which decides each morning whether conditions are safe. We only use licensed, insured operators with experienced pilots.

faq.question: What happens if the flight is cancelled?
faq.answer: If the authority cancels flights for wind or weather, we try the next morning during your stay or refund you in full. Booking for your first morning gives the best chance.

faq.question: How long is the flight?
faq.answer: About one hour in the air. The whole experience, from pick-up to return, takes about three to three and a half hours.

faq.question: How many people are in the basket?
faq.answer: Standard baskets carry up to about 20 people in separate compartments. Comfort baskets take fewer passengers, and a private basket for your group can be arranged.

faq.question: Is there a minimum age?
faq.answer: Most operators accept children from about 6 years old with an adult. Pregnant travellers are not allowed to fly.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Warm layers, as dawn is cold even in summer, a hat and flat closed shoes. It is warm close to the burners.

faq.question: When is the best season?
faq.answer: April to November has the most reliable flying weather. Winter flights are beautiful over the snow but are cancelled more often.

faq.question: Can people with limited mobility fly?
faq.answer: You must climb into a basket using steps and hold a landing position, so serious back, knee or heart problems may make it unsuitable. Tell us in advance.

faq.question: Which hotels do you pick up from?
faq.answer: Hotels in Göreme, Uçhisar, Ürgüp, Avanos and Ortahisar. For other locations, ask us.

faq.question: Can I bring my camera or phone?
faq.answer: Yes. Use a wrist strap; drones are not allowed. Operators also sell photos and videos taken during the flight.

faq.question: What if I am afraid of heights?
faq.answer: Many nervous flyers enjoy it, as the balloon rises very gently. If you prefer, you can watch the balloons rise from a sunrise viewpoint instead.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the flight. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
